# Geometry, convexity and transport: changed-premise audit

Research date: 7 October 2026. Shared protocol read in full. Source claims remain conditional until independently validated. No external publication, messages, installs or cloud computation occurred.

## Decisive routes and status

1. **Convex analytic composition.** Released family 091 supplies an even moment-coordinate tensor inequality. Its proof appears to extend from same-degree powers of linear forms to arbitrary even convex homogeneous polynomial summands, including mixtures of degrees. The resulting multivariable partition-function theorem is derived below. This is an extraction of a stronger reusable interface, conditional on the source's tensor, moment-map and density lemmas. No global priority claim is made.
2. **Transport endpoint extension.** Released family 374 and Astra L08 give the sharp W2 one-third modulus for compact uniform convex and compact full-dimensional log-concave sources. A potential direct extension to arbitrary bounded-density compact sources remains unresolved. The simple truncation composition through a dimension-free linear-TV estimate is false: independent agent gives a fixed disconnected source of density below 8 and arbitrarily many sites for which squared map error / TV diverges. The full exact construction is in the agent's report.

The initial KLS composition was rejected as a novelty target and as an unsupported proof: 093's psi2 premise is not acquired by 101's sharp entropy bound. Exact regular-simplex and product-exponential obstructions appear in `convex_bridge_audit/BRIDGE_AUDIT.txt`. New KLS claims were read to their base/cumulant/suspension interfaces; this audit does not certify them.

## A derived mixed-homogeneous partition theorem

Let psi_i be nonzero, nonnegative, even, convex homogeneous polynomials on R^d, of degrees q_i >= 2. The degrees may differ. Let epsilon > 0 and

    V(x) = epsilon |x|^2/2 + sum_i psi_i(x),
    mu(dx) = Z^{-1} exp(-V(x)) dx.

Conditional on family 091's moment-coordinate tensor and density lemmas at this interface,

    Cov_mu(psi_1,...,psi_m) <= diag(E_mu psi_i)

in the PSD order, i.e.

    Var_mu(sum_i b_i psi_i) <= sum_i b_i^2 E_mu psi_i.

Consequently

    t -> log integral exp[-epsilon |x|^2/2 - sum_i exp(t_i) psi_i(x)] dx

is jointly concave on R^m. Positive prefactors can be absorbed into the homogeneous summands.
